title: A Day at the Museum
setting: A bright art museum with large white walls.

characters.name: Sara
characters.look: Sara (a young woman of about twenty-five with a long black ponytail, a white shirt and a mustard-yellow skirt)

characters.name: Kofi
characters.look: Kofi (a man of about thirty with dark skin, a shaved head, a short black beard and a light-blue shirt)

sentences.en: Sara and Kofi visit the art museum today.
sentences.zh: 萨拉和科菲今天去参观美术馆。
sentences.scene_prompt: Sara (a young woman of about twenty-five with a long black ponytail, a white shirt and a mustard-yellow skirt) and Kofi (a man of about thirty with dark skin, a shaved head, a short black beard and a light-blue shirt) walk up the steps of a big art museum.

sentences.en: Sara is an artist with paint on her hands.
sentences.zh: 萨拉是一位画家，手上沾着颜料。
sentences.scene_prompt: Sara (a young woman of about twenty-five with a long black ponytail, a white shirt and a mustard-yellow skirt) stands in a bright museum hall holding a brush, her hands covered in colourful paint.

sentences.en: One painting shows a tall actor on a stage.
sentences.zh: 有一幅画画的是舞台上一位高个子演员。
sentences.scene_prompt: Sara (a young woman of about twenty-five with a long black ponytail, a white shirt and a mustard-yellow skirt) and Kofi (a man of about thirty with dark skin, a shaved head, a short black beard and a light-blue shirt) look at a large painting on a white museum wall; the painting shows a tall actor in a costume on a theatre stage.

sentences.en: Another painting shows a band with a guitar.
sentences.zh: 另一幅画画的是一支有吉他的乐队。
sentences.scene_prompt: A large painting on a white museum wall shows a small band of musicians, one playing a guitar.

sentences.en: Next to it, a man plays piano music.
sentences.zh: 在它旁边，一个男人在弹钢琴曲。
sentences.scene_prompt: A man plays a grand piano in a bright museum hall next to paintings.

sentences.en: Kofi also takes a photograph of the piano player.
sentences.zh: 科菲还给弹钢琴的人拍了一张照片。
sentences.scene_prompt: Kofi (a man of about thirty with dark skin, a shaved head, a short black beard and a light-blue shirt) holds up a camera toward a man at a grand piano.

sentences.en: Sara draws a picture in her small book.
sentences.zh: 萨拉在她的小本子上画了一幅画。
sentences.scene_prompt: Sara (a young woman of about twenty-five with a long black ponytail, a white shirt and a mustard-yellow skirt) sits on a museum bench and sketches the piano player in a small sketchbook.

sentences.en: Art is the reason for Sara's big smile.
sentences.zh: 艺术就是萨拉笑得这么开心的原因。
sentences.scene_prompt: Sara (a young woman of about twenty-five with a long black ponytail, a white shirt and a mustard-yellow skirt) smiles widely in front of colourful paintings while Kofi (a man of about thirty with dark skin, a shaved head, a short black beard and a light-blue shirt) smiles at her.
sentences.draw_note: Shows Sara beaming in front of the paintings; the idea of 'reason' can't be drawn.
